lines.say: Almost half of Israel's pharmacists come from one minority. Guess which.
Arab citizens. They are twenty one percent of Israel.
So what share of Israel's health jobs do they hold? Start at the pharmacy.
Behind the pharmacy counter, in twenty ten: twenty eight percent. By twenty twenty three: forty nine.
Nurses: twenty seven percent. Dentists: twenty seven.
And doctors? In twenty ten, eight percent.
By twenty twenty three: twenty five. More than triple.
Of all new doctors licensed since twenty ten: thirty eight percent.
That's the next generation of Israeli medicine.
Some call Israel apartheid. This is a test almost nobody runs.
The same study says real gaps remain. Equality isn't finished.
So next time you pick up medicine in Israel, look at the name tag.
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
Because almost half of Israel's pharmacists come from one minority.

sources.label: Rosen and Miaari, Israel Journal of Health Policy Research

caption_en:
The last number is the one nobody talks about. 🩺

Arab citizens are 21% of Israel. Their share of its health workforce:
💊 Pharmacists: 49% (2023), up from 28% in 2010. Almost half.
🩺 Doctors: 8% (2010) to 25% (2023). More than triple.
Nurses 27%. Dentists 27%.
🎓 Of new physician licences 2010 to 2022: 38%.

Some call Israel apartheid. This is a test almost nobody runs. The same study says real gaps and challenges remain: equality isn't finished.

Next time you pick up medicine in Israel, look at the name tag.
caption_he:
כמעט חצי מהרוקחים בישראל באים ממיעוט אחד. 🩺
אזרחים ערבים הם 21% מאוכלוסיית ישראל. החלק שלהם בכוח האדם ברפואה:
💊 רוקחים: 49% (2023), לעומת 28% ב 2010.
🩺 רופאים: 8% (2010) עד 25% (2023). יותר מפי שלושה.
אחיות 27%. רופאי שיניים 27%.
🎓 מרישיונות הרופאים החדשים 2010 עד 2022: 38%.
אותו מחקר אומר שנשארו פערים ואתגרים אמיתיים: השוויון עוד לא הושלם.
בפעם הבאה שאתם קונים תרופה בישראל, תסתכלו על תג השם.

Source: Rosen B, Miaari S. "Arab representation in Israeli healthcare professions: achievements, challenges and opportunities", Israel Journal of Health Policy Research 14:7 (2025). 2023 shares include Arab residents of east Jerusalem; employed professionals up to age 67.
